newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Romania OTC shares fall on profit-taking.
newsitem.headline: Romania OTC shares fall on profit-taking.

text.p: Romania's over-the-counter (OTC) market touched further lows on Monday as profit-taking cut the gains of the past few weeks, traders said.

Lower prices for heavyweight shares pushed the two independent indices, the VAB-RASDAQ and the BIG-OTC, down 2.33 and 3.58 percent to 3,679.27 and 2,770.25 points, respectively. Traders expected a recovery after mid-week.

"This downtrend cannot go on and on. Prices of high-caps seem to have reached levels which are acceptable for buyers," one trader said. "Some players might be tempted to drive prices down further for a day or two."

The session's most traded stocks were cement makers Romcif and Casial. Romcif closed 100 lei weaker at 1,800, while Casial gained 50 lei to 2,300. Romcim, another cement maker and the star of the market in recent months, fell 5,000 lei to 65,000. Traders did not expect the shares to fall further.
Oil refinery Arpechim lost ground, shedding 3,000 lei to close at 28,000. Operators forecast that Arpechim might dip to 26,000 on Tuesday under selling pressure.
Total volume was 2.47 million shares worth 6.93 billion lei, sharply down from 14.36 billion previously.
